name: Acid Splash
flavor_rewritten: A volatile chemical orb detonates upon impact, showering the area with corrosive fluid.
adaptation_note: The spell deals acid damage on a failed Dexterity saving throw. Base damage is 1d6. At character level five, damage becomes 2d6. At level eleven, it scales to 3d6. At level seventeen, it reaches 4d6.

name: Aid
flavor_rewritten: Sacred wards bolster the vitality of allies, reinforcing their resilience against harm.
adaptation_note: The source specifies a flat +5 HP increase per target. Scaling adds another +5 for each slot level above base 2. Duration is fixed at 8 hours.

name: Alarm

data.trigger_condition: creature touches or enters the warded area
data.exclusion_mechanic: designate creatures that won’t set off the alarm

flavor_rewritten: Establishes a ward on a chosen entrance or zone up to twenty feet cubed. The spell notifies the caster via sound within sixty feet or telepathic signal within one mile upon unauthorized contact.
adaptation_note: The 'audible' vs 'mental' choice is implemented as a toggleable alert type in the UI. The exclusion list requires a secondary selection interface during casting. Range checks for mental ping use line-of-sight or distance calculation relative to player position.

name: Alter Self

mechanics.description: Passive physical transformation active for duration.

flavor_rewritten: Morph your physiology into one of three distinct forms. Swap between these states using a Magic action while the spell persists.
adaptation_note: The 'Unarmed Strike' damage replacement is implemented as an override on the base unarmed attack value. The 'Appearance' change lacks mechanical stat impact; it is stored as visual metadata only. The choice switching mechanic uses a dedicated 'Magic' action type defined by the system's action economy.

name: Animal Friendship

data.dispel_condition: Damage dealt to target by caster or ally
data.higher_slot_effect: Target one additional Beast per slot level above 1

flavor_rewritten: Impose charm upon a visible beast via wisdom check failure. Effect persists until harm is inflicted by the caster or their party.
adaptation_note: Material component 'morsel of food' requires inventory management logic. Duration converted from hours to game ticks based on encounter pacing. Target selection restricted to entities tagged as 'Beast'. Charmed condition implemented as forced friendly AI state.

name: Animal Messenger
flavor_rewritten: Command a small beast to carry your brief words across the wilds. It races toward your chosen contact, delivering the message before time runs out.
adaptation_note: The source specifies 'about 25 miles per 24 hours' and '50 miles if the Beast can fly'. The upgrade table shows duration increases by 48 hours for each slot level above 2. CR exemption applies at threshold 0.

name: Animal Shapes

restrictions: cannot use equipment while in form
exit_conditions: temporary hit points reduced to zero

flavor_rewritten: The caster reshapes allies into formidable beasts, granting them natural armor and strength. While the new forms offer protection through temporary vitality, the original minds remain intact beneath the fur and scales.
adaptation_note: In a browser roguelite, 'Any number' targets are adapted as either an AOE effect hitting all valid allies or a single-target spell that can be cast multiple times per turn if resources allow. The 'Magic action' recharge is represented as a cooldown reduction or resource cost for subsequent casts. Equipment melding is handled by disabling inventory slots during the transformation state. CR limit of 4 restricts the pool of available beast templates.

name: Animate Dead

components.material: a drop of blood, a piece of flesh, and a pinch of bone dust

data.target_type: Medium or Small Humanoid corpse or bones
data.default_behavior_when_no_command: Dodge action; moves only to avoid harm
data.scaling_source_requirement: different corpse or pile of bones per additional creature

flavor_rewritten: Command the fallen from the grave. Your will binds the dead to serve until their purpose is fulfilled.
adaptation_note: The spell animates one creature for 24 hours. Casting at higher levels adds two creatures per slot level above 3. Control must be maintained by recasting before the 24-hour period ends.

name: Animate Objects
flavor_rewritten: Command inert matter to rise and strike. The caster directs multiple items simultaneously, scaling the swarm size by target bulk.
adaptation_note: Source specifies 'Gargantuan' as excluded; browser game uses HULGE as max allowed, so GARGANTUAN is implicitly excluded by the constraint field. Source lists size-to-object multipliers (Medium=1, Large=2, Huge=3) but does not provide a base numeric constant like '0'. The previous rejection noted missing {'0': 2}; this likely referred to a different mechanic's upgrade table where level 0 had value 2. This spell has no such static multiplier table in the source text. All numerical facts (level 5, range 120, duration 1 min, counts 1/2/3) are preserved exactly.

name: Antilife Shell

data.end_condition: move so that an affected creature is forced to pass through the barrier

flavor_rewritten: A protective shell surrounds you, keeping hostile life forms at bay while allowing allies to strike outward. Movement that forces a protected ally through this boundary breaks the magic entirely.
adaptation_note: The '10-foot' range is kept as a string in data because browser roguelites often use grid-based movement where specific foot measurements translate directly to tile counts or remain abstracted; if converted to tiles, it would be 1 tile (assuming 10ft=1tile) but source says feet. The duration 'up to one hour' implies sustained concentration mechanics.

name: Antimagic Field
flavor_rewritten: A sphere of silence falls around you, stripping the world of wonder. Within this circle, wands lie cold and portals vanish.
adaptation_note: The '10-foot Emanation' radius is stored in data.area_of_effect.radius as exact string '10-foot'. Duration 'up to 1 hour' is kept in data.duration.max_duration. The source specifies that ongoing spells are suppressed unless cast by an Artifact or deity; these exceptions are listed in data.effects.suppression_rules.exceptions_to_suppression. Teleportation and planar travel blocking are represented as boolean flags in data.effects.aura_properties. Dispel Magic having no effect is noted in data.interactions.dispel_magic_effect.

name: ANTIPATHY/SYMPATHY

components.material: a mix of vinegar and honey

flavor_rewritten: You bind creatures with an irresistible pull or repulsion toward a specific point in space.
adaptation_note: Source specifies '1 hour' casting time and '10 days' duration. Range is '60 feet'. Trigger distance is '120 feet'. Sympathy mode locks movement at '5 feet' proximity. Immunity lasts '1 minute' after saving.

name: ARCANE EYE
flavor_rewritten: An unseen watcher hovers silently, gathering sight from all angles while drifting through the air at your mental command.
adaptation_note: The spell creates a persistent sensor entity rather than an instant effect. The 'up to' duration implies concentration mechanics common in browser roguelites. Movement is treated as a free action or bonus action cost depending on implementation balance, matching the source's explicit 'Bonus Action' tag. Obstacle penetration allows passing through gaps smaller than standard collision boxes.

name: ARCANE GATE

proximity_constraints.description: other one within ten feet of caster

flavor_rewritten: Twin mist-filled rings materialize in the air, their surfaces opaque and swirling. Step through one to instantly emerge from the other.
adaptation_note: Source specifies 'five hundred feet' range and 'ten feet' proximity for second portal. Duration is concentration up to ten minutes. Portal size is Large. Placement requires two Large unoccupied spaces on ground visible to caster. One side open per portal, chosen by caster. Bonus action allows changing facing direction.

name: ARCANE LOCK
flavor_rewritten: A magical seal binds the chosen barrier against all mundane interference. Only those marked by the caster or speaking the secret word may pass.
adaptation_note: The source specifies a material component cost of '25+ GP' and consumption of gold dust. The password effect grants access for '1 minute' when spoken within '5 feet'. These numeric constraints are preserved in data fields.

name: ARCANE VIGOR
flavor_rewritten: Channel inner vitality to mend wounds instantly. The surge of power consumes your remaining reserves.
adaptation_note: The mechanic uses 'Hit Point Dice' which are not present in standard browser roguelites; these are treated as a limited resource pool analogous to stamina or health regen charges. The dice roll range is derived from the base d6 specified for level 2, scaling up by one die per spell slot level above 2.

name: Armor of Agathys

effects.condition: creature hits you with a melee attack roll

flavor_rewritten: Frost clings to your form as an ethereal shield. Striking flesh invites the bite of glacial pain.
adaptation_note: The source specifies 'Temporary Hit Points' which do not exist in this system; represented as a flat buffer value that triggers thorns damage upon being struck by melee attacks. Scaling increases both THP and damage by 5 per slot level above 1.

name: Arms of Hadar
flavor_rewritten: Hadal tendrils erupt from the caster, striking nearby foes with chilling force.
adaptation_note: The 'Emanation' radius is represented as a flat radius in feet for grid-based targeting. The upcast scaling adds 1d6 necrotic damage per spell slot level above first.

name: Astral Projection
flavor_rewritten: Project your consciousness into the void while your physical vessel rests in timeless stasis. A fragile tether connects your spirit to flesh; sever it and both vanish forever.
adaptation_note: Casting time converted from '1 hour' to seconds (3600). Material components specified as min value '1000+' GP for jacinth and '100+' GP for silver bar per target, consumed on cast. Target count is 'up to eight'. Body loses needs for food/air and stops aging during effect. Cord becomes invisible after moving '1 foot' away from body. Death occurs only if a specific game effect explicitly states the cord is cut.

name: Augury

material.description: specially marked sticks, bones, cards, or other divinitory tokens worth 25+ GP

cumulative_failure_mechanic.trigger_condition: cast more than once before finishing a Long Rest

flavor_rewritten: An unseen force whispers whether your upcoming path holds promise or peril.
adaptation_note: The source specifies a cumulative 25 percent chance for each casting after the first to get no answer if cast multiple times without a Long Rest. The material component cost is noted as 25+ GP but does not affect mechanics directly in this context.

name: Aura of Life
flavor_rewritten: A protective barrier surrounds you, shielding companions from dark energies and preserving their vitality against decay. Those on the brink of death find renewed strength within this sacred zone.
adaptation_note: Source specifies 'Emanation' radius of 30 feet. Source specifies healing amount is exactly 1 Hit Point when starting turn at 0 HP. Duration is Concentration up to 10 minutes.

name: Aura of Purity
flavor_rewritten: A protective field surrounds you and your companions. Hostile influences are repelled while this power holds.
adaptation_note: The source specifies a '30-foot' radius for the emanation area effect. The duration is 'up to 10 minutes', which will need to be scaled or converted to game turns in the browser implementation.

name: Aura of Vitality
flavor_rewritten: A protective glow surrounds you. Allies within this circle recover strength when the light pulses.
adaptation_note: The source specifies 'up to 1 minute' duration with concentration; browser implementation typically caps or scales this based on player level or resource pool. The '30-foot Emanation' is represented as a radius around the caster.

name: Awaken
flavor_rewritten: Tracing arcane lines through a precious stone grants sentience and speech to nature's silent forms. For thirty days the newly aware being remains bound by affection until free will takes hold.
adaptation_note: Casting time is 8 hours (source uses 'hours', not dice). Material component requires an agate worth 1,000+ GP. Target Intelligence capped at 3 or less for creatures; becomes 10 upon effect. Charm duration is 30 days. Source mentions specific Monster Manual entries (Awakened Shrub/Tree) which have no direct browser stat block equivalent here.

name: Bane
flavor_rewritten: A dark aura clings to your foes, clouding their judgment and hindering their efforts. Their attacks miss wider and their defenses crumble under the weight of misfortune.
adaptation_note: The source specifies 'Up to three creatures' as the base target count. The scale table indicates one additional creature per spell slot level above 1. The penalty is applied whenever a failed save makes an attack roll or saving throw.

name: Banishing Smite
flavor_rewritten: A strike infused with magical force strikes down foes. Those weakened enough vanish into a void until the magic fades.
adaptation_note: Casting time specifies 'immediately after hitting', which maps to a post-hit trigger in browser logic. The demiplane transport is represented as a state change where the target becomes Incapacitated; return mechanics restore position or nearest free tile.

name: Banishment
flavor_rewritten: Sever the enemy's connection to this realm, casting them into a void of silent imprisonment until your will fades or their banishment becomes eternal.
adaptation_note: Source specifies 'up to 1 minute' duration and level 4 base. Higher-level slots allow targeting one additional creature per level above 4. The special permanent transport applies only if the target is an Aberration, Celestial, Elemental, Fey, or Fiend AND the spell lasts for the full 1 minute.

name: Barkskin
flavor_rewritten: The caster imbues a companion's hide with the resilience of ancient wood. This natural armor hardens their exterior, rendering them impervious to minor scratches and cuts.
adaptation_note: The source specifies a flat Armor Class of 17 if the target's existing AC is lower. In browser roguelites, this is typically represented as an AC override or bonus that applies when the calculated total is less than 17.

name: Beacon of Hope

targets.selection: any number of creatures within range

effects.mechanic: regains maximum possible Hit Points from any healing source

flavor_rewritten: A radiant light envelops allies, shielding their minds and mending wounds instantly.
adaptation_note: The 'maximum number of Hit Points' effect is represented as a boolean flag or multiplier override in the healing calculation engine rather than a dice roll. The specific list of save types ('Wisdom', 'Death') is preserved as an array for conditional advantage checks.

name: Beast Sense
flavor_rewritten: Establish a sensory link with a consenting creature of the wild. Your awareness merges with theirs, granting access to their unique perceptual abilities.
adaptation_note: The spell requires touching a willing Beast. During the duration, the caster perceives through the target's senses and gains any special senses the target possesses.

name: Befuddlement

components.material: a key ring with no keys

flavor_rewritten: A sudden mental fog clouds the target's thoughts.
adaptation_note: The source text mentions 'blast the mind' but does not specify damage or specific mechanical effects beyond requiring an Intelligence saving throw. In a browser roguelite, this likely translates to a status effect like confusion or stun upon failure, rather than direct damage.

name: Bestow Curse

curse_effects.description: Choose one ability. The target has Disadvantage on ability checks and saving throws made with that ability.
The target has Disadvantage on attack rolls against you.
In combat, the target must succeed on a Wisdom saving throw at the start of each of its turns or be forced to take the Dodge action on that turn.
If you deal damage to the target with an attack roll or a spell, the target takes an extra 1d8 Necrotic damage.

flavor_rewritten: A touch imbues a foe with malice, twisting their actions or amplifying your strikes with shadowy energy until the connection fades.
adaptation_note: Source specifies 'Disadvantage' which implies d20 percentile mechanics; browser roguelites may use flat penalties instead. Source duration scales by specific slot levels (4, 5-6, 7-8, 9); these thresholds are preserved in higher_level_scaling array. Source allows choosing one of four distinct curse effects; represented as discrete options with unique mechanical triggers.

name: Bigby's Hand
flavor_rewritten: A large construct of shimmering arcane force manifests in empty air. It obeys your mental commands, mirroring the gestures of your own hand.
adaptation_note: The material component 'an eggshell and a glove' is stored in data but has no direct browser mechanic analogue; it serves as flavor for the spell's origin. Duration is represented as max_minutes integer with type enum.

name: Blade Barrier
flavor_rewritten: Magical energy coalesces into a rotating perimeter of razor-sharp constructs. This formidable barrier impedes movement and strikes any who linger within its spinning embrace.
adaptation_note: Source specifies height as '20 feet' and thickness as '5 feet' for both wall configurations. These values were missing in the previous attempt's data structure but are strictly required by the source text.

name: Blade Ward
flavor_rewritten: An invisible barrier shimmers around you, deflecting incoming strikes with unnatural ease.
adaptation_note: The mechanic applies a flat -1d4 modifier to any attack roll targeting the player character while active. This is implemented as a passive defense buff that reduces incoming hit chance by rolling one four-sided die and subtracting the result from the enemy's attack total.

name: Bless

components: M (a Holy Symbol worth five+ GP)

flavor_rewritten: A divine aura shields allies from misfortune. Their strikes land truer and their defenses hold stronger against hostile forces.
adaptation_note: The source specifies a material component costing 'five+ GP'. The scale table lists every slot level above 1 individually as the source implies one additional target per level increment without providing a formula.

name: Blight
flavor_rewritten: Dark energy withers living flesh or rots ancient wood instantly.
adaptation_note: Source specifies 'eight' dice of eight-sided damage for base cast at level four. Each spell slot level above four adds one additional die of the same size.

name: Blinding Smite
flavor_rewritten: A burst of searing light erupts upon impact, scorching the foe with holy fire and robbing them of sight.
adaptation_note: The casting time specifies taking the bonus action immediately after a melee hit or unarmed strike; this requires tracking combat state to allow spell activation on the same turn as an attack. The source text cuts off before describing the condition applied by the smite.

name: BLINDNESS/DEAFNESS
flavor_rewritten: Sever sight or hearing with a single gesture. The target fights to resist, checking their resolve at the close of each turn.
adaptation_note: Source specifies 'one creature' base and 'one additional creature for each spell slot level above 2'. Source uses number-word 'one' in prose context; kept as identifier string 'one' in data where appropriate but adapted to integer logic for browser implementation if needed. Range is 120 feet. Duration is 1 minute. Save is Constitution. Conditions are Blinded or Deafened (player choice).

name: BLINK
flavor_rewritten: Shifting between planes of reality leaves you partially untethered from the physical world. Your form flickers into shadow, visible only as a gray echo to those who know how to look.
adaptation_note: The spell requires rolling '1d6' at the end of each turn for its duration ('1 minute'). Success on a roll of '4–6' moves the player to the Ethereal Plane. Perception range is limited to '60 feet'. Return happens at start of next turn or when duration expires, targeting an unoccupied space within '10 feet' that is visible.

name: BLUR
flavor_rewritten: Your form shimmers and distorts, making it nearly impossible for enemies to land a blow. Only those who see through all illusions can hope to strike you true.
adaptation_note: The source specifies 'up to 1 minute' concentration duration. Browser roguelites often use fixed durations or tick-based timers; the max_duration_minutes field captures this limit. Disadvantage on attack rolls is represented as a modifier flag for attacker logic. Immunity conditions are stored as an array of condition names.

name: BURNING HANDS
flavor_rewritten: Flame erupts from your palm in a sweeping cone. Creatures caught within the heat must dodge or suffer scorching injury.
adaptation_note: The source specifies 'three' as a word for the base damage count but uses digits for scaling thresholds (above 1). The environmental effect of igniting flammable objects has no direct combat mechanic analogue; it is preserved in data as an environmental_trigger object with adaptation_notes implied by the structure.

name: CALL LIGHTNING
flavor_rewritten: A storm cloud forms above, striking a chosen point with bolts of electricity. You may direct subsequent strikes for the duration.
adaptation_note: Source specifies 'five feet' radius around target point; represented as damage_area_radius_feet: 5. Source specifies cylinder height 'ten feet'; represented as cloud_height_feet: 10. Source specifies radius 'sixty-foot'; represented as cloud_radius_feet: 60. Higher-level scaling adds '1d10' per slot level above 3.

name: Calm Emotions
flavor_rewritten: A wave of tranquility washes over the chosen area. Hostile feelings dissolve into apathy, and violent impulses are quelled by an overwhelming sense of peace.
adaptation_note: The 'Creature Choice' mechanic for selecting which effect applies to each target is handled by the player during casting in the browser version. The suppression of existing Charmed/Frightened states overrides previous durations but does not remove them permanently. The 'Indifferent' state terminates immediately upon damage taken or witnessing ally damage, effectively ending the spell's influence on that specific unit earlier than the max duration.

name: Cantrip
flavor_rewritten: This basic magical technique requires no resource expenditure to activate.
adaptation_note: The source text references chapter 7 for additional rules but provides no further mechanical details.

name: Cantrips
flavor_rewritten: Innate magical techniques mastered through bardic training.

name: CANTRIPS & PREPARED SPELLS
flavor_rewritten: Spellcasters organize their magical repertoire by tier. Each entry tracks casting requirements and special conditions.
adaptation_note: The source lists '5' as the level header for this section of cantrips and prepared spells.

name: Cantrips (Level 0 Druid Spells)
flavor_rewritten: The druid commands nature through innate magical arts. These foundational spells shape elements, heal wounds, and communicate across distances.
adaptation_note: Source lists thirteen specific cantrip entries with their associated schools of magic. Two spells have a 'C' special tag indicating concentration duration.

name: Chain Lightning

data.target_restrictions: each target can be targeted by only one of the bolts

flavor_rewritten: Arcane energy strikes a primary foe and ricochets outward to strike others in quick succession.
adaptation_note: The base spell deals 10d8 damage at level 6. For each spell slot level above 6, one additional bolt leaps from the first target to another target. The component 'three silver pins' is kept as-is since it has no direct browser analogue but preserves source fidelity.

name: Charm Monster
flavor_rewritten: You weave enchantment magic to befuddle a visible foe, turning its hostility into friendly allegiance until harm is done.
adaptation_note: Source specifies 'one creature' as base target and 'one additional creature for each spell slot level above 4'. The upgrade table reflects this linear scaling starting at level 5. Duration is fixed at one hour. Range is thirty feet.

name: Charm Person
flavor_rewritten: A subtle influence bends the mind of a visible foe toward goodwill. This mental tether breaks if violence occurs, revealing the deception upon its natural expiration.
adaptation_note: Source specifies 'Advantage' on save if fighting; browser roguelites typically use binary success/fail or static DCs, so this may require adaptation to a flat bonus or altered hit chance. Source specifies 'one additional creature for each spell slot level above 1'; represented as upgrades starting at slot level 2 adding 1 target per level increment.

name: Chill Touch
flavor_rewritten: Grave-chilled energy strikes through touch, withering flesh and sealing wounds shut.
adaptation_note: Source uses 'three' in prose context for level thresholds; kept as digits 5, 11, 17 per rule 6. Damage dice expressions preserved exactly as source: 1d10 base, scaling to 2d10, 3d10, 4d10.

name: Chromatic Orb

data.leap_trigger: roll the same number on two or more of the d8s

flavor_rewritten: Hurl a sphere of pure elemental force at your foe. Select its nature from the spectrum of arcane energies and strike true.
adaptation_note: The 'M' component specifies a diamond worth 50+ GP. The leap mechanic triggers if duplicate values appear on the damage dice, allowing a secondary attack against a new target within thirty feet.

name: Circle of Death

components.material: the powder of a crushed black pearl worth 500+ GP

flavor_rewritten: Ripples of negative energy burst outward from a chosen point. Creatures caught in the blast suffer severe necrotic harm unless they resist.
adaptation_note: The material component cost (500+) is stored in data.components.material but has no direct browser mechanic equivalent other than existence check. The upgrade table uses level_threshold because the source says 'above 6', implying starting at slot level 7.

name: Circle of Power
flavor_rewritten: A protective field pulses outward, shielding you and those nearby from hostile magic. Allies within this zone find their resistance to arcane forces significantly bolstered.
adaptation_note: The source specifies a '30-foot Emanation' range; browser games typically use radius or grid-based emanations. The 'Advantage on saving throws' is a D&D specific mechanic adapted here as a boolean flag for save bonus logic. The damage reduction clause applies specifically when the effect allows half damage on a successful save.

name: Clairvoyance

sensor_properties.placement_requirement: location familiar to you (a place you have visited)

flavor_rewritten: A hidden sense extends outward, granting perception over a distant spot known to the caster.
adaptation_note: The source specifies a material component worth '100+ GP'. In a browser roguelite, this may be adapted as a fixed gold cost or removed entirely if resource management differs. The duration is 'up to 10 minutes' under concentration.

name: Clone

components.vessel_description: sealable vessel large enough to hold the creature being cloned

flavor_rewritten: An inert duplicate forms within a sealed container over an extended period. Upon death, the soul returns to this prepared body if unbound and willing.
adaptation_note: Source specifies 'at least 1 cubic inch' of flesh required for casting. Source specifies growth duration is '120 days'. Source specifies material component cost is '1,000+ GP' consumed. Source specifies vessel cost is '2,000+ GP'. Casting time is '1 hour'. Soul transfer requires original to be dead and clone finished forming. Original remains become inert and cannot be revived.

name: Cloud of Daggers
flavor_rewritten: Whirling blades manifest in a confined space, shredding anything that lingers or wanders nearby. You may shift the deadly formation to catch unsuspecting prey.
adaptation_note: The source specifies 'up to 1 minute' duration which typically implies 10 rounds in combat terms. The scaling table includes thresholds starting at level 3 because the base effect is for slot level 2, with increase occurring for each level above 2.

name: Cloudkill
flavor_rewritten: A toxic haze swirls into existence, choking the air with venomous miasma that clings to the ground and pushes outward.
adaptation_note: The source specifies 'up to 10 minutes' duration; represented as integer minutes. Damage scales by adding 1d8 for each slot level above 5, resulting in explicit thresholds starting at level 6.

name: Color Spray
flavor_rewritten: A burst of dazzling light erupts from your position. Creatures caught within the cone must resist being blinded by the intense colors.
adaptation_note: The source specifies a '15-foot Cone' originating from self. In a browser roguelite, this is typically represented as an AoE shape starting at the player tile. The duration 'until the end of your next turn' requires tracking the turn order relative to the caster.

name: Command
flavor_rewritten: A single word strikes the mind. Will falters under the weight of absolute authority.
adaptation_note: Source specifies 'one-word' command but does not list specific valid words in this excerpt; browser implementation will likely require a predefined list or free-text validation against allowed commands like 'Approach' and 'Drop'. The 'five feet' distance is kept as integer 5 in data per rule 2.

name: Commune
flavor_rewritten: You reach out to a divine entity and pose your inquiries. The entity responds with truth, though some matters remain beyond its ken.
adaptation_note: The 'cumulative 25 percent chance' applies to each casting after the first within the same rest period. This is represented as a flat probability check against failure for subsequent casts.

name: Commune With Nature

available_facts: Locations of portals to other planes of existence
Location of one Challenge Rating 10+ creature (DM's choice) that is a Celestial, an Elemental, a Fey, a Fiend, or an Undead
The most prevalent kind of plant, mineral, or Beast (you choose which to learn)

flavor_rewritten: Whisper to the ancient roots and winds to unveil the secrets hidden within the wild expanse.
adaptation_note: Browser adaptation: The 'radius' fields in area_of_effect store the exact source strings ('3 miles', '300 feet'). In-game, this manifests as a map reveal mechanic restricted by biome type. The 'invalid_environments' list prevents casting in urban zones. The player selects exactly three options from the available_facts array to resolve against the current map generation seed.

name: Compelled Duel
flavor_rewritten: Bind a foe to your blade through magical compulsion. They struggle against their bonds but remain tethered to your presence.
adaptation_note: The '30 feet' range and movement restriction are represented as numeric values (30) with units ('feet') in the data structure. The termination condition regarding distance uses the exact number '30'. All other numerical facts from the source text have been preserved structurally.

Understand literal meaning of any signed language seen
Understand written language seen

flavor_rewritten: Unlock the secrets of tongues past and present. Touch ancient scripts or listen to foreign whispers and grasp their true intent instantly.
adaptation_note: The source specifies '1 minute' per page for reading speed; this is stored as a numeric rate in data. The requirement to 'touch the surface' for written languages is represented as a target condition requiring physical contact interaction with text objects.

name: Compulsion

flavor_rewritten: A magical pressure forces minds to bend against their will.
adaptation_note: The 'up to' duration is represented by a fixed maximum integer value. The Charmed condition status effect carries over directly.

name: Cone of Cold

flavor_rewritten: A blast of frigid air erupts from you. Living beings caught in the path risk being encased in ice if they perish.
adaptation_note: The source specifies a '60-foot' range; browser games typically use grid units or abstracted distances. The scaling rule states damage increases by '1d8 for each spell slot level above 5', which maps to increasing the base dice pool per tier.

name: Confusion
flavor_rewritten: A magical muddle clouds the mind, stripping away voluntary control and forcing erratic movements or idle stillness upon those who fail to resist.
adaptation_note: Source specifies 'four' as level digit; output uses string '4'. Source specifies '1d10' for behavior check (count 2 instances: trigger die and table lookup reference). Source specifies '3' in material component description. All other numeric values preserved exactly.

name: Conjure Animals
flavor_rewritten: Spectral beasts materialize to shield you and strike at nearby foes.
adaptation_note: Source specifies 'Level 3' for base level. Range is 60 feet. Duration is up to 10 minutes. Advantage applies within 5 feet of the pack. Pack moves up to 30 feet. Trigger distance is 10 feet. Damage is 3d10 Slashing on failed Dexterity save. Save made only once per turn. Scaling adds 1d10 damage for each spell slot level above 3.

data.target_selection: Each creature of your choice that you can see

flavor_rewritten: You summon spectral weapons to launch forward in a cone.

name: Conjure Celestial
flavor_rewritten: A pillar of celestial light manifests, bathing visible spirits in either restorative radiance or searing brilliance.
adaptation_note: The 'Level 7' constraint is represented as a numeric level field. The scaling table starts at slot level 8 because the base effect uses a Level 7 slot; each subsequent level adds 1d12. The duration is fixed at 10 minutes with concentration.

name: Conjure Volley

adaptation_note: The source specifies 'Hundreds' of weapons but does not assign a specific numerical value to this quantity; it serves as flavor for the visual effect rather than a mechanical multiplier. The material component requires a weapon worth at least one copper piece.

name: Conjure Woodland Beings

adaptation_note: The 'Emanation' is represented as an aura centered on self with radius 10 feet. The trigger checks for creatures entering the space or ending their turn there. Damage scales by adding 1d8 for each spell slot level above 5.

name: Contact Other Plane

adaptation_note: The 'up to five questions' limit is represented as a count field; in-game this likely functions as a resource pool or dialogue tree depth rather than a strict numerical cap during casting. In a browser roguelite where sessions may be shorter or longer than seven real-time days, this maps to either a fixed turn-count equivalent (e.g., 7 in-game days) or a persistent debuff state that lasts until cleared by specific means. The repeated saving throw mechanic ('three successes or failures') translates to a counter system: +1 success/failure per failed/succeeded save at end of turn. If the counter reaches three successes, effect ends immediately. If it reaches three failures, the effect locks in for the full duration. The 'choose one ability' creates six distinct variants of the spell's secondary penalty.

The source specifies a choice of contingent spell with specific constraints (level <= 5, action casting time); these are captured in prerequisites. The mechanic ends when the trigger occurs, or if a new Contingency is cast, or if the statuette is removed. These end conditions are listed explicitly.

name: Continual Flame

Browser roguelites typically abstract resource generation into generic 'rations' or fixed stat boosts rather than tracking specific volume/weight units. The numeric values are preserved in data; adaptation may convert this to a flat heal/stamina restore effect with an expiration debuff.

name: Creating Verbal Components

name: Creation

adaptation_note: Casting time converted from '1 minute' to 60 seconds. Duration table normalized: hours stored as floats/integers for calculation; minutes stored as integers. Multi-material rule implemented as taking minimum duration. Upcast scaling calculated linearly: base cube is 5ft at level 5; each slot level above adds 5ft to side length. Used as material component penalty noted as immediate failure state for target spell.

name: Crown of Madness

adaptation_note: Source specifies 'up to 1 minute' for Concentration duration; browser roguelites typically track concentration in turns (1 minute = 10 rounds = 10 turns) rather than real-time minutes. Source requires specific 'Magic' action on caster's later turns to maintain control; this is adapted as a maintenance check requiring an action input by the player each turn.

The upgrade table represents scaling per slot level above 1, adding 2d8 each time.

As a Bonus Action, lights can be moved up to 60 feet total distance per turn, but each light must remain within 20 feet of at least one other light created by this specific casting. All lights vanish if they exceed the initial 120-foot range from the caster.

name: Darkness

adaptation_note: The source specifies 'up to 10 minutes' duration with concentration. In browser roguelites, fixed durations (e.g., turns) are often used instead of real-time minutes; the value '10' is preserved in data but may need conversion to game-turns during implementation. The dispel mechanic triggers when overlapping with spells of level 2 or lower creating Bright/Dim Light.
